status.detail: On clean exact upstream source, the production build command returned zero and its MSBuild log reports success; the existing production assembly predates that run, so fresh emission is not claimed. The unit-test build failed in CsWinRTGenerateProjection with a native cswinrt.exe failure and MSB3073. Source-only contract tracing established that projection inputs come from resolved WinMD references, not ordinary managed project references. Empty project inputs are not proof of a missing prerequisite: the production project succeeded with the same empty slot. The crash remains unexplained. A focused diagnostic sequence is assigned; no test assembly, discovery, tests, or TRX exists, and no upstream defect or review conclusion is claimed.
